kelas.deskripsi: Centralized Standard Inpatient Rooms as regulated by the Ministry of Health, with a nurse station per cluster and card access accompanying family.
Private suite with a family waiting area, bathtub bathroom and a personal case manager throughout the stay.
Obstetrics area: high risk antenatal care and a delivery room (VK) staffed 24/7 by obgyns and midwives.

intensif.deskripsi: Negative pressure and laminar airflow zones that break the chain of infection, monitored by the IPC (Infection Prevention Control) team every shift.

Airborne Infection Isolation Room (AIIR), HEPA Filter, Anteroom
